hook_text: A windpump turns the Karoo wind into a drink of water for the sheep. What goes in, and what comes out?
clip_script: A Karoo farm. The wind pushes the windpump wheel. Wind movement in, water pumped out! A power station hundreds of kilometres away sends electricity along wires to the farmhouse. Kettle: electricity in, heat out. Radio: electricity in, sound out. Torch: battery in, light out. Tractor: diesel in, movement out. But touch an old light bulb. Ouch! Hot. Wasted energy. Input in, useful output out, and a little always wasted.
visual_style: Whiteboard Karoo farm with arrows carrying energy from the wind to the windpump, from a power station along wires to a kettle, and from a battery to a torch; each machine labelled with input and output.
mood: Clever and practical, like a farm full of machines.
pacing: Follow energy from its source to the job, then label inputs and outputs, then spot the wasted energy.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and label the input and output energy of three appliances at home.
